verdict.rationale: Tailscale has its own programmatic surface. The docs describe automating a tailnet via infrastructure-as-code providers and integrations, and a community user mentions API keys, which implies an API exists. Nothing shows the API matches the admin UI feature for feature, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. missing for 10: documented API reference, evidence of API/UI parity across admin features (users, policy file, devices, DNS), published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of full API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Automate your tailnet using infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks, and other integrations.
API keys expire after 60 days, requiring manual login to renew.
